title: MediaTek says its board has approved a discretionary $5B financing budget to support long-term growth, including its expansion into AI chips for data centers (Wen-Yee Lee/Reuters)
summary: Wen-Yee Lee / Reuters: MediaTek says its board has approved a discretionary $5B financing budget to support long-term growth, including its expansion into AI chips for data centers — MediaTek (2454.TW), Taiwan's largest chip designer, said on Friday its board had approved a discretionary financing budget …
